decisions.reason: Premium customer support is tightly bound to the firm's core promise of tailored expert service, so despite limited later visibility management is likely to justify and retain it rather than reverse course.

The software version management tool builds on the firm's technical platform and prior development effort and supports its automation-oriented direction, which makes continued commitment more likely than withdrawal.

Scalable hosting for agencies was launched as a flagship line and sits at the center of the firm's announced strategic path, so public commitment and invested resources strongly favor keeping it on the market.
